title: Zika virus
snippet:
In February 2016, WHO declared Zika-related microcephaly a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). The causal link between the Zika virus and congenital malformations was confirmed, and the PHEIC declaration was lifted in November 2016.
 Although cases of Zika virus disease declined globally from 2017 onwards, transmission persists at low levels in several countries in the Americas and in some countries in Asia and Africa, where sporadic outbreaks have also been documented. Outbreaks of Zika virus disease were identified throughout most of the Americas and in other regions with established Aedes aegypti mosquito populations.
